title: Topics a technician training program must cover on the examination route
rule_summary: Under 247 CMR 8.02(3)(e)3.a, an applicant for a pharmacy technician license who relies on a Board-approved passing score on a Board-approved pharmacy technician assessment examination after completing a Board-approved pharmacy technician training program must have completed a training program that includes coverage of the topics of job descriptions, pharmacy security, commonly used medical abbreviations, routes of administration, product selection, final check by pharmacists, guidelines for the use of pharmacy technicians, and any other requirements of the Board.
exam_relevance: Tests that a training program on the examination route is judged by its required topic coverage as well as by the program categories and hour minimums in 247 CMR 8.02(4).

authority.name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Pharmacy regulations

common_confusions: Meeting the 120-hour theoretical and 120-hour practical minimums of 247 CMR 8.02(4)(c) does not by itself show the required topic coverage.
The topic list ends with any other requirements of the Board, so it is not closed.
verification_notes: Read in the official Board of Registration in Pharmacy publication of 247 CMR 8.00 (the mass.gov PDF) on 2026-09-11. Added as a new rule so that no released adjudication is disturbed.
